page.notes: Woodcut initial L (ornamental frame) joined to "Oco", read as LOco. Printed rules and small marks in the margins and between the paragraphs are not text. Doubtful readings: "Nequo" (line beginning "Nequo modo", possibly "Neque"), catchword "Ia" at lower right (the last letter is unclear).
